name: It bag
summary: The handbag that a house makes as the object of one season. It has a new shape in a bold material, a small run and a waiting list. A star carries it, and the street copies it within months.

philosophy.core_thesis: A single bag can carry the whole fashion of a season, and its scarcity is part of its design.
design_principles: Give the bag one clear shape that a child can draw: a short strap bag, a saddle, a padlock tote.
Name the bag, so that people ask for it by name.
Cover it in a bold surface: beads, python skin, patent, studs or a woven weave.
Make a small first run, under 5,000 pieces, with a waiting list.
Give it to a star in the first month, so that the press shows it.
Carry it under the arm or on the shoulder, 20 to 30 cm wide.
Add a heavy gilt hardware piece as the second sign.
Offer it in a new material or colour each season.
anti_patterns: A plain basic bag in black calfskin
A large run in every shop
A bag that matches the shoes

silhouette.shape: A compact, easy shape with a short strap, a bold surface and heavy hardware.
silhouette.line: A soft, short curve of the strap, and a clear shape on the hip.
silhouette.fit: The bag is worn under the arm or on the shoulder, and is seen in profile on the street.
silhouette.proportion: Bag 20–35 cm wide, 10–25 cm high; strap drop 12–20 cm; hardware 3–6 cm.
rules: Make one shape and repeat it in many surfaces.
Use a bold surface at the front and keep the back plain.
Fit a heavy gilt piece: a buckle, a padlock or a chain.
Keep the bag small enough to carry all day.

fabrics.rule: Pick a rich, bold surface that photographs well: beaded satin, python skin, patent or woven calfskin.

methods: hand-sewn beads and sequins on satin
python skin cut on the pattern
construction.closures: A magnetic flap, a turn-lock or a padlock with a key on a leather tab.
construction.details: A short strap, heavy gilt hardware, a named tag inside and a dust bag with the name of the bag.

surface.pattern: Beads, sequins, a woven weave, a python scale, studs or a bold stripe on the front.
surface.gloss: Beads and patent at 80–100 GU; calfskin at 20–35 GU; suede at 2–5 GU.
surface.wear: The bag wants to be new and kept in its dust bag; the star of the season ends when the next bag arrives.

palette.strategy: A bold colour or a metallic for the season, with gilt hardware; a black version for the second year.

making.scale: A small first run in a few shops with a waiting list, then a wider run in more colours within a year.
making.signs: Dense, even beads or weave, matched skin pattern at the seams and heavy, well-cast hardware.

pieces.form: Short strap bag covered in beads and sequins
Saddle-shaped shoulder bag with a metal initial buckle
Python skin bag with a gilt chain
Patent clutch with a jewelled clasp
Slouch hobo in suede with a padlock

positive: python skin bag with gilt chain

emotion.target_response: A sense of desire and of inside knowledge: the viewer wants the bag that everyone names.

use_cases: a fashion image prompt for a 2000s star look
a brief for one hero accessory in a collection
a study of the launch of a handbag
a window display of a seasonal bag
avoid_when: the brief wants a plain, long-lasting basic
the brief wants a quiet, unmarked bag

modifiers.how: Drop the name, the beads and the hardware; keep the shape in plain calfskin.
Make the shape a firm box with a flap, and match it to the shoes.

ornament_level.note: A plain version has gilt hardware only; the full version is covered in beads or skin.
